meta.scope: Michelin Guide restaurants, San Francisco Bay Area (verified rows only)
meta.method: Each row opened on its official guide.michelin.com restaurant page. Star icons, address, cuisine, price tier, website and phone were read from that page. Hours are shown only where the page displayed them; otherwise they are blank and flagged.
meta.pricing_note: Michelin shows only a price tier ($ to $$$$), not a dollar amount. No official per-person or two-adult total was verified, so the two-adult price column is blank for every row.
meta.social_note: No YouTube, TikTok or Instagram links have been verified yet. The column is blank by design.
